short_description: Recurring HVAC failures in Studio B — aging rooftop compressor
description: Root cause: the rooftop HVAC compressor serving Studio B is past its service life and short-cycling under load, causing repeated cooling failures during afternoon lessons. Temporary recharges have not held. Building manager recommends compressor replacement under the lease maintenance agreement.

short_description: Front entrance smart lock battery drain causing lockouts
description: Root cause: the smart lock module on the Grand Blvd main entrance drains batteries faster than expected, leading to intermittent code rejections and staff lockouts. Need a scheduled battery-replacement cadence or a hardwired power option for the lock.
